parquet.writer_options: FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 100000, PARQUET_VERSION V1, WRITE_BLOOM_FILTER false

files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
kdi_method: issue id: rows of the file in the scope of an active row of pipeline/known_data_issues.csv (dataset, file month, entity and the issue condition; values kept as published)
